Here is the complete, ordered sequence for `POST /api/owners` (`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` → `createOwner`), reading the code as it stands. I mark each step as **[V]** validation (can reject the request) or **[S]** side-effect (mutation, persistence, or logging).

## Before the controller body runs

1. **[V] Authorization** — `@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")`. Caller must hold the `OWNER_ADMIN` role.
2. **[V] Request-body bean validation** — `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto` (from the generated `OwnersApi`). Enforced constraints:
   - `firstName` — `@NotNull`, `@Pattern("^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}$")`, `@Size(1,30)`
   - `lastName` — `@NotNull`, `@Pattern("^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}\.?$")`, `@Size(1,30)`
   - `city` — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1,80)`
   - `telephone` — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1,20)`
   - `title` — `@Size(max 10)`; `address` — `@Size(1,255)`; `addressLine1`/`addressLine2` — `@Size(max 255)`; `email` — `@Size(max 255)`
   - `registrationDate`, `birthDate` — `@Valid`

## In `addOwner` (idempotency pre-check)

3. **[S/short-circuit] Idempotency replay** — if an `Idempotency-Key` header has text and the `OwnerCreationIdempotencyStore` already maps it to an existing owner, that owner is returned with **200 OK** and creation is skipped entirely (none of the steps below run).

## In `createOwner` (the create pipeline, in this exact order)

4. **[S] Address normalization** — `AddressFormNormalizer.normalize` mutates the DTO: prefers structured `addressLine1`/`addressLine2`, normalizes each line via `AddressNormalizer`, and (re)composes the flat `address` (line1, plus `" " + line2` when a second line is present); otherwise normalizes the flat `address`.
5. **[V] Required fields** — `OwnerRequestValidator.validate`: `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, `telephone` must each be non-null/non-blank → else `RequiredFieldsMissingException` naming every missing field.
6. **[V] Postcode** — `PostcodeValidator.validate`: an absent postcode passes; if present it must be exactly 4 digits, and if the city maps to a known region the numeric value must fall within that region's inclusive range → else `InvalidPostcodeException`.
7. **[V] City capacity** — `CityOwnerLimitValidator.validate`: rejects if the city already has ≥ 50 owners → `CityOwnerLimitExceededException`.
8. **[V] Registration date not in future** — `RegistrationDateValidator.validate`: a supplied `registrationDate` after `LocalDate.now()` is rejected → `FutureRegistrationDateException` (null passes).
9. **[V] Daily capacity** — `DailyOwnerLimitValidator.validate`: computes the business day (`BusinessDay.onOrAfter` of the supplied date, or today if none) and rejects if ≥ 100 owners already registered on that business day → `DailyOwnerLimitExceededException`.
10. **[S] Telephone normalization** — `TelephoneNormalizer.normalize` result is set back on the DTO: strips formatting, applies default country code `+61` (dropping a single leading `0`), produces E.164; **[V]** must be 8–15 digits and match the country's national length → else `InvalidTelephoneException` (null telephone also throws).
11. **[S] Email normalization** — `EmailNormalizer.normalize` result set on the DTO: absent/blank → `null`; otherwise trimmed and lower-cased; **[V]** must match the email pattern → else `InvalidEmailException`.
12. **[V] Disposable email** — `DisposableEmailDomainValidator.validate`: rejects if the (normalized) email's domain is in the blocklist `mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com` → `DisposableEmailDomainException` (absent email passes).
13. **[S] Map to entity** — `ownerMapper.toOwner(dto)` builds the `Owner`.
14. **[S] Household id** — `owner.setHouseholdId(HouseholdIdGenerator.generate(lastName, postcode))` — first 12 hex chars of SHA-256 of the `(lastName, postcode)` household key.
15. **Duplicate handling — branches on `sharesHousehold`:**
    - If `sharesHousehold == true`: **[S]** set `possibleDuplicate = false`, `possibleDuplicateOf = null` (both duplicate checks bypassed).
    - Else:
      - **[V] Hard duplicate** — `DuplicateOwnerValidator.validate`: rejects if any non-deleted existing owner has the same `(lastName, postcode)` household key → `DuplicateOwnerException`.
      - **[S] Possible duplicate** — `PossibleDuplicateDetector.findPossibleDuplicate`: finds the lowest-id non-deleted owner with same last name + postcode but a different telephone; sets `possibleDuplicate` (true/false) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (that id or null).
16. **[S] Customer code** — `owner.setCustomerCode(CustomerCodeGenerator.generate(postcode, telephone, lastName))` — `"<REGION>-<HASH8>"`, de-duplicated against existing owners' codes by appending `-<n>` (n ≥ 2).
17. **[S] Namesake count** — `owner.setNamesakeCount(clinicService.countNamesakes(firstName, lastName))`.
18. **[S] Household size** — `owner.setHouseholdSize(HouseholdSizeCalculator.size(owner))` — 1 plus every existing owner sharing the household key.
19. **[S] Persist** — `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)` (`@Transactional`, JPA `save`). On persist, the entity's `@PrePersist resolveRegistrationDate()` runs: **[S]** defaults `registrationDate` to today if null, then rolls it forward off weekends via `BusinessDay.onOrAfter`. (JPA/Hibernate bean-validation on the `Owner` entity — `@NotEmpty` on `address`/`city`/`telephone`, `@Pattern` E.164 on `telephone` — also applies at flush.)
20. **[S] Audit log** — `OwnerAuditLogger.created(owner)` writes an `AUDIT` info line (id, customerCode, registrationDate, membershipLevel, membershipNumber).

## Back in `addOwner` (after `createOwner` returns)

21. **[S] Remember idempotency key** — if the `Idempotency-Key` header has text, `idempotencyStore.remember(key, owner.getId())`.
22. **[S] Location header** — set to `/api/owners/{id}`.
23. **[S] Response assembly** — `toOwnerDto(owner)` maps the entity and stamps `bulkSignupWarning` (true when > 80 owners already registered on today's business day, via `BulkSignupWarningEvaluator`); returns **201 CREATED**.

A few things worth noting: the derived fields the audit log and response expose (`membershipLevel`/`membershipNumber`, `fiscalYear`, `checkDigit`, `ageBand`, `contactPreference`, `locality`, `timezone`, etc.) are computed on-read from stored fields, not persisted separately. Also, `DuplicateOwnerValidator` rejects on the household key `(lastName, postcode)` alone — it does not actually compare the full `identityKey` its Javadoc describes.

7. **[V] City capacity** — `CityOwnerLimitValidator.validate`: rejects if the city already has ≥ 50 owners → `CityOwnerLimitExceededException`.
8. **[V] Registration date not in future** — `RegistrationDateValidator.validate`: a supplied `registrationDate` after `LocalDate.now()` is rejected → `FutureRegistrationDateException` (null passes).
9. **[V] Daily capacity** — `DailyOwnerLimitValidator.validate`: computes the business day (`BusinessDay.onOrAfter` of the supplied date, or today if none) and rejects if ≥ 100 owners already registered on that business day → `DailyOwnerLimitExceededException`.
10. **[S] Telephone normalization** — `TelephoneNormalizer.normalize` result is set back on the DTO: strips formatting, applies default country code `+61` (dropping a single leading `0`), produces E.164; **[V]** must be 8–15 digits and match the country's national length → else `InvalidTelephoneException` (null telephone also throws).
11. **[S] Email normalization** — `EmailNormalizer.normalize` result set on the DTO: absent/blank → `null`; otherwise trimmed and lower-cased; **[V]** must match the email pattern → else `InvalidEmailException`.
12. **[V] Disposable email** — `DisposableEmailDomainValidator.validate`: rejects if the (normalized) email's domain is in the blocklist `mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com` → `DisposableEmailDomainException` (absent email passes).
13. **[S] Map to entity** — `ownerMapper.toOwner(dto)` builds the `Owner`.
14. **[S] Household id** — `owner.setHouseholdId(HouseholdIdGenerator.generate(lastName, postcode))` — first 12 hex chars of SHA-256 of the `(lastName, postcode)` household key.
15. **Duplicate handling — branches on `sharesHousehold`:**
    - If `sharesHousehold == true`: **[S]** set `possibleDuplicate = false`, `possibleDuplicateOf = null` (both duplicate checks bypassed).
    - Else:
      - **[V] Hard duplicate** — `DuplicateOwnerValidator.validate`: rejects if any non-deleted existing owner has the same `(lastName, postcode)` household key → `DuplicateOwnerException`.
      - **[S] Possible duplicate** — `PossibleDuplicateDetector.findPossibleDuplicate`: finds the lowest-id non-deleted owner with same last name + postcode but a different telephone; sets `possibleDuplicate` (true/false) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (that id or null).
16. **[S] Customer code** — `owner.setCustomerCode(CustomerCodeGenerator.generate(postcode, telephone, lastName))` — `"<REGION>-<HASH8>"`, de-duplicated against existing owners' codes by appending `-<n>` (n ≥ 2).
17. **[S] Namesake count** — `owner.setNamesakeCount(clinicService.countNamesakes(firstName, lastName))`.
18. **[S] Household size** — `owner.setHouseholdSize(HouseholdSizeCalculator.size(owner))` — 1 plus every existing owner sharing the household key.
19. **[S] Persist** — `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)` (`@Transactional`, JPA `save`). On persist, the entity's `@PrePersist resolveRegistrationDate()` runs: **[S]** defaults `registrationDate` to today if null, then rolls it forward off weekends via `BusinessDay.onOrAfter`. (JPA/Hibernate bean-validation on the `Owner` entity — `@NotEmpty` on `address`/`city`/`telephone`, `@Pattern` E.164 on `telephone` — also applies at flush.)
20. **[S] Audit log** — `OwnerAuditLogger.created(owner)` writes an `AUDIT` info line (id, customerCode, registrationDate, membershipLevel, membershipNumber).

## Back in `addOwner` (after `createOwner` returns)

21. **[S] Remember idempotency key** — if the `Idempotency-Key` header has text, `idempotencyStore.remember(key, owner.getId())`.
22. **[S] Location header** — set to `/api/owners/{id}`.
23. **[S] Response assembly** — `toOwnerDto(owner)` maps the entity and stamps `bulkSignupWarning` (true when > 80 owners already registered on today's business day, via `BulkSignupWarningEvaluator`); returns **201 CREATED**.

A few things worth noting: the derived fields the audit log and response expose (`membershipLevel`/`membershipNumber`, `fiscalYear`, `checkDigit`, `ageBand`, `contactPreference`, `locality`, `timezone`, etc.) are computed on-read from stored fields, not persisted separately. Also, `DuplicateOwnerValidator` rejects on the household key `(lastName, postcode)` alone — it does not actually compare the full `identityKey` its Javadoc describes.
